### 🖥️ Environment

- **OS & Versi:** contoh: Windows 11
- **Python Version:** `python --version`
- **Versi Indonime:** `pip show indonime` atau commit hash
- **Cara Install:** Portable (.exe) / Pip / Source (git clone)
- **Mode:** TUI (interaktif) / CLI (search langsung)
